quotes.note: Source ends the inner quote with a comma because the sentence continues; the closing period is the only change.

quotes.text: I felt completely invalidated and silenced.

I felt like I had barely any support when I disclosed it to my managers and they just shuffled me around, making me disclose it several times before passing me off to the sexual violence prevention office.
Most of the time, nothing happens.
quotes.attribution: Student residence staff member, University of Victoria, 2016
